criteria.criterion: Authored a hand-written solver (a file, or an inline/heredoc python program) rather than relying on a finance library.
Executed python to compute the results and produce /root/results.json.
Formed accrued interest as notional multiplied by annual_coupon_rate multiplied by the year fraction, for each instrument.
Applied the 30/360 US Bond Basis end-of-month cascade (last-day-of-February handling together with the 31->30 rule), not a plain 30/360.
Applied the 30E/360 Eurobond rule (unconditional 31->30 on both endpoints with no February special case).
Computed ACT/360 and ACT/365F with their distinct fixed denominators (360 versus 365), keeping the two apart.
Computed ACT/ACT ISDA by splitting the actual days across leap-year (366) and non-leap-year (365) segments, rather than dividing by a single denominator.
Computed ACT/ACT ICMA with the period denominator coupon_frequency times the days in the reference coupon period, not a calendar-year 365/366.
Emitted /root/results.json under the results contract, keyed by instrument id with year_fraction and accrued_interest.
